metadata.question: Does the burn scar area in Apalachicola National Forest's Bradwell Bay Wilderness increase between early April, 2004, and late April, 2004?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Apalachicola National Forest, Bradwell Bay Wilderness (Northern Florida, USA) - Time periods: Early April 2004 (April 1-10) vs Late April 2004 (April 21-30) - Collection: Landsat 5 or 7 for 2004, using thermal/SWIR bands for burn detection (NBR - Normalized Burn Ratio) 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking to get clear observations - Use NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) to detect burned areas: NBR = (NIR - SWIR2) / (NIR + SWIR2) - Lower NBR values indicate burned areas - Calculate burned area by thresholding NBR 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - C1: If no images found in either period - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - A: If burn scar area increased from early to late April - B: If burn scar area decreased or stayed same ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Bradwell Bay Wilderness in Apalachicola National Forest const bradwellBay = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-84.55, 30.15], [-84.55, 30.25], [-84.45, 30.25], [-84.45, 30.15], [-84.55, 30.15]] ]); // 2. Define time periods const earlyApril = ['2004-04-01', '2004-04-10']; const lateApril = ['2004-04-21', '2004-04-30']; // 3. Function to mask clouds for Landsat 5/7 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // 4. Function to calculate NBR function addNBR(image) { const nbr = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B7']).rename('NBR'); return image.addBands(nbr); } // 5. Acquire Landsat 7 data for early April let earlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(bradwellBay) .filterDate(earlyApril[0], earlyApril[1]) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); const earlySize = earlyCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Early April images: ${earlySize}`); if (earlySize === 0) { // Try Landsat 5 earlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(bradwellBay) .filterDate(earlyApril[0], earlyApril[1]) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); const earlySize2 = earlyCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Early April images (Landsat 5): ${earlySize2}`); if (earlySize2 === 0) { console.log('No data for early April 2004'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 6. Acquire Landsat 7 data for late April let lateCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(bradwellBay) .filterDate(lateApril[0], lateApril[1]) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); const lateSize = lateCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Late April images: ${lateSize}`); if (lateSize === 0) { // Try Landsat 5 lateCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(bradwellBay) .filterDate(lateApril[0], lateApril[1]) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); const lateSize2 = lateCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Late April images (Landsat 5): ${lateSize2}`); if (lateSize2 === 0) { console.log('No data for late April 2004'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 7. Create composite images const earlyImage = earlyCol.median().select('NBR'); const lateImage = lateCol.median().select('NBR'); // 8. Check for valid pixels const earlyCount = earlyImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: bradwellBay, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const lateCount = lateImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: bradwellBay, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`Early April valid pixels: ${earlyCount}`); console.log(`Late April valid pixels: ${lateCount}`); if (earlyCount === 0 || lateCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Define burn threshold (NBR < 0.1 indicates potential burn) const burnThreshold = 0.1; const earlyBurn = earlyImage.lt(burnThreshold); const lateBurn = lateImage.lt(burnThreshold); // 10. Calculate burn areas in square meters const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const earlyBurnArea = earlyBurn.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: bradwellBay, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const lateBurnArea = lateBurn.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: bradwellBay, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`Early April burn area: ${(earlyBurnArea / 1e6).toFixed(2)} sq km`); console.log(`Late April burn area: ${(lateBurnArea / 1e6).toFixed(2)} sq km`); // 11. Validation and final answer if (earlyBurnArea === null || lateBurnArea === null || isNaN(earlyBurnArea) || isNaN(lateBurnArea)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results'); console.log('C3'); return; } const increase = lateBurnArea - earlyBurnArea; console.log(`Change: ${(increase / 1e6).toFixed(2)} sq km`); if (lateBurnArea > earlyBurnArea) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
